packageRules.description: The secrets server is OpenBao, not Vault, and its pin is tag+digest in group_vars/all.yml. The rule named hashicorp/vault, the pre-migration package, so it guarded nothing after 2026-11-10. OpenBao supports only the newest minor, and an upgrade needs a release-notes read and an unseal rehearsal, so the pin moves on a quarterly operator cadence rather than in the daily PR stream. See docs/services/openbao.md.
Locally built images have no upstream to look up; their build base is covered by the dockerfile manager instead.

forgejo and nginx live in compose/group_vars/all.yml, which has no digest field for forgejo. Digest pinning these two is deferred to docs/musings/digest-pinning-plan.md so the compose default and the Ansible var cannot drift apart.
One PR per ecosystem's patch-level churn instead of one per package.
Minor updates stay separate so a bad minor is one revert away from a known-good patch state.
Major updates take the same 24-hour hold as everything else; the label is the human signal to look at the changelog before promoting.

Forgejo stays on the 15 LTS line until the 17 move is planned and rehearsed. 16 is end-of-life, so a 16 bump is a downgrade in support terms, and 17 wants its own plan rather than a dependency PR. Ruling: dec_3zkrzkwwdu50. Plan: docs/plans/forgejo-17-upgrade.md.

customManagers.description: Forgejo image tag in the Ansible vars. group_vars/all.yml is what the first-boot compose .env is rendered from, so bumping only the compose default would not reach a fresh install.
nginx image in the Ansible vars (same first-boot .env reason as forgejo).
